scope: Jarvis reliability and execution roadmap. These are recorded engineering states; query live connections before claiming an action can run.

items.title: Primary-server diagnostics
items.evidence: Deployed 064eec7; actual chat executed server_status in 6.1 seconds. Owner-only access tested.

items.title: Phone connection and safe commands
items.evidence: Actual server-to-phone ping and battery-status receipts in 4 and 5 seconds.
items.next: Test each effectful command with phone approval.

items.title: Validated signed APK release
items.evidence: Android compile, receipt unit tests and emulator checks passed on 064eec7. PR 95 merged; signed release pipeline triggered.
items.next: Verify signed APK publication and installation.

items.title: PC connection and startup
items.evidence: Portable executable built and runtime-tested. No paired PC in live audit. User chose to connect later.
items.next: Pair in Devices, paste credential locally, verify ping and approved app launch.

items.title: Gmail sending and Google Calendar
items.evidence: Gmail read connected; send and Calendar scopes absent. User chose to reconnect later.
items.next: Complete Google consent, then test read/write separately.

items.title: Accurate capability readiness
items.evidence: Audited 69 tools; smart-home/TV/visual labels need dependency checks.
items.next: Expose actual integration/device requirements rather than only tool registration.

items.title: Phone background connection
items.evidence: Current APK companion stops when the app leaves the foreground.
items.next: Add explicit background session, harmless probes and waiting-command notification; retain approval for effects.

items.title: Restricted server operations and repair
items.evidence: Health/logs exist; restart executor is absent. Maintenance edits only permitted WebUI/skill files.
items.next: Build bounded operations, tests, approval and rollback; do not grant unrestricted root.

items.title: Verified music playback
items.evidence: Search/queue and existing-stream controls exist. No universal player or audible playback proof.
items.next: Connect player state/errors and explicit device targeting.

items.title: Persistent tasks and proactive monitoring
items.evidence: Schedules and optional repair proposals exist; general durable task execution is absent.
items.next: Add persisted tasks, checkpoints, retries, cancellation, completion criteria and quiet notifications.

items.title: Consented screen and application automation
items.evidence: Atulya UI controls are not full phone/desktop screen control.
items.next: Add consented screen sessions and scoped desktop automation after device pairing.

items.title: Camera-to-answer visual inspection
items.evidence: Current visual tool queues capture only; current phone lacks take_photo ability.
items.next: Implement capture/upload/analysis and verify the resulting answer.

items.title: WhatsApp and email command channels
items.evidence: Telegram connected. No native WhatsApp channel or email inbox command listener found.
items.next: Implement adapters with authorized accounts, webhook/inbox setup and delivery tests.

items.title: Home Assistant and TV control
items.evidence: Handlers exist; no verified Home Assistant or paired TV in this audit.
items.next: Connect real devices, discover allowed targets and verify each action.
